documents.title: About Lovely Professional University
documents.text: Lovely Professional University (LPU) is a private university in Chiheru (Chaheru), Phagwara, Punjab, India. It was established under the Lovely Professional University Act, 2005 and commenced operations in 2006. The campus is around 90 acres. Official website: https://www.lpu.in/. Brand colour is orange.

Lovely Professional University (LPU) is a private university in Chiheru (Chaheru), Phagwara, Punjab, India. It was established under the Lovely Professional University Act, 2005 and commenced operations in 2006. The campus is around 90 acres. Official website: https://www.lpu.in/. Brand colour is orange.

documents.title: LPU leadership and location
documents.text: LPU founder and chancellor is Ashok Kumar Mittal. Pro-chancellor is Rashmi Mittal. The university is located near Phagwara in Punjab (PIN commonly associated with campus area 144411). Approximate coordinates: 31.25°N, 75.70°E. The campus is about 8 km from Phagwara railway station.

documents.title: Schools and programmes
documents.text: LPU has schools covering business, fashion design, engineering, law, education, agriculture, humanities, and tourism. Distance education programmes are approved by the UGC Distance Education Bureau.

documents.title: Affiliations and recognition
documents.text: LPU is recognised/affiliated with bodies such as UGC, Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), and Bar Council of India (BCI). School of Agriculture is accredited by ICAR. Other memberships/accreditations include NBA, Council of Architecture (CoA), NCTE, and Association of Commonwealth Universities (ACU).

documents.title: NIRF and international rankings
documents.text: In NIRF 2025, LPU was reported around overall rank 49 and universities rank 31. Category ranks reported include management ~44, pharmacy ~13, engineering ~48, law ~26, architecture ~24. Times Higher Education listed LPU in the 501–600 band; QS World University Rankings 2026 band reported around 901–950.

documents.title: Campus facilities overview
documents.text: LPU campus includes academic blocks, hostels, library, sports facilities, shopping/food courts, medical support, and admin offices. Academic buildings are commonly referred to by Block numbers (for example Block 29, 32, 33, 34, 38). Students usually locate classes by course code + block + room.

documents.title: Library and learning resources
documents.text: LPU has a central library with books, journals, and digital resources for enrolled students. Students typically need a valid ID card for library access. Quiet study areas and computer access are available during library hours. For exact timings, check the latest notice on the LPU student portal or library desk.

documents.title: Hostels and residential life
documents.text: LPU provides on-campus hostel accommodation for students with separate residential areas and mess facilities. Hostel allotment, room change, and leave permissions are handled through hostel administration / Uni-Hostel processes. Visitors and late-night entry follow hostel rules.

documents.title: Transport and getting to campus
documents.text: Campus is near Phagwara, Punjab. Common arrival points are Phagwara railway station and nearby bus stands, then local taxi/auto to campus. Students living off-campus often use university or private transport routes. Always verify current shuttle information from transport notices.

documents.text: Campus medical facilities support basic health needs for students and staff. For emergencies, contact campus security / medical helpdesk immediately and inform a warden or faculty mentor. Keep emergency contacts saved in your phone.

documents.title: How to find a class location
documents.text: To find where a class is happening, ask LPUGPT with the course code (example: Where is CSE301?). LPUGPT reads the live course location from the campus database. If a teacher moves a class mid-way, the new location is updated in the database and appears in answers immediately.

documents.title: How teachers update class data
documents.text: Teachers and admins can update live campus data by chatting naturally, for example: Move CSE301 to Block 38 Room 401, or Announce CSE301: bring laptops tomorrow. Only the assigned teacher (or an admin) can mutate that course. Students can query but cannot change locations.

documents.title: Student portal and LMS
documents.text: Students use the LPU student UMS/portal for attendance, results, fee status, and academic records. Course materials may also appear on the learning platform used by faculty. If login fails, use official password reset or IT helpdesk — never share passwords with others.

documents.title: What LPUGPT can and cannot do
documents.text: LPUGPT answers from: (1) this campus knowledge base, (2) live course/update records in the database. It must not invent room numbers, fee amounts, ranks, or policies not present in retrieved context. If data is missing, it should say it does not have that information and suggest checking the official LPU portal or helpdesk.

documents.title: Account and data safety
documents.text: Never share passwords, OTPs, or session cookies. Teachers can only update courses they own. Students only see courses they are enrolled in. Suspicious requests (asking for other students' private data) should be refused.
